findings_summary: The control defect is not publication multiplicity itself; it is that three distinct P022 subfrontiers share one task_id, making task-global ownership and ordinary non-cohort runtime selection ambiguous. All three publications should remain retained evidence and later receive distinct typed task identities/objective bindings. Until that split is materialized, TP2-DE338F269CA11E9BC01B is selected only as the temporary operational publication because its taskbook explicitly carries the highest-priority expired legacy HANDOFF and the first-reentry q=3r-1 arithmetic core. This operational choice is not a mathematical truth, quality, or priority judgment over the two retained routes.
